h1: Multi-Tier Steamer Pot for Institutional Kitchens and Caterers
short_description: Steaming cooks food gently and keeps it moist. This multi-tier steamer pot stacks several round tiers with perforated bases on top of a base with legs, so steam rises through every level at the same time. The side handles make each tier easy to lift. It is built for kitchens, caterers and processors that steam in bulk, and it can be made in the metal that suits your product. Kenyan caterers often look for it simply as a galvanised steamer pot.

sections.heading: Key Features and Benefits
sections.body:
Stacked tiers. Several tiers are heated by the same source, so you steam many portions at once instead of one batch after another, saving fuel and time.

Perforated bases. Holes in each base let steam rise evenly through the whole stack, so the food on every level cooks consistently.

Side handles. Each tier has handles, so staff can lift and swap tiers safely.

Base on legs. The base stands on legs above the heat source and is stable on a stove or fire.

Made to order. Tier size, tier count and metal can be adjusted to suit your product and fuel.

sections.heading: Who It Suits
sections.body: Institutional kitchens, caterers, bakeries, food processors and shops that steam food in volume.

sections.heading: What to Check Before Buying
sections.body: Tell us exactly what you will steam and the quantity, so we can recommend the right metal, size and number of tiers. For food use, ask about stainless steel or aluminium options.

sections.heading: Care and Maintenance
sections.body: Wash each tier after use, dry it fully and keep it in a dry place. Clean the perforations so steam flows freely.

sections.heading: In Practice
sections.body: Fill the base with water to the level marked by your fabricator, keep the perforated bases clear and stack the tiers carefully so the steam rises through every level. Use the side handles with dry cloths or gloves, because the metal gets hot. After use, empty the water, wash each tier, dry it completely and store it upside down so it never holds moisture.

sections.heading: How Kenyan Kitchens Choose
sections.body:
Caterers and food processors in Kenya search for a galvanised steamer pot or a multi tier steamer when they need to cook large batches with steam instead of boiling. Buyers compare the number of tiers, the material and whether the base is stable over the fire, so we explain these clearly before you order.

Many of our customers first search for a food steamer Kenya online and then call us to confirm the size. Send us your details and we will give honest advice.

sections.heading: Fit It to Your Space
sections.body: Kitchens differ, so we do not force one size on everybody. Share your layout, your daily volume and your budget, and we will recommend what works and tell you honestly what you can skip.
